claims.text: The hotel is on Rajadamri Road, with direct BTS Skytrain access via a skybridge.

findings.quote: situated in Bangkok’s key commercial corridor and prime shopping precinct, Rajadamri Road, with direct BTS Skytrain access via skybridge.

claims.text: The hotel looks out over the greenery of The Royal Bangkok Sports Club and the Siam skyline.

findings.quote: Revel in unobstructed views of the greenery of The Royal Bangkok Sports Club and the skyline of Siam Bangkok from our luxury hotel.

claims.text: The Erawan Shrine, Siam Paragon, Central World and Lumphini Park are nearby.

findings.quote: Find us near many of Bangkok's elite business institutions, superb local restaurants, boutique shops, and attractions like the Erawan Shrine, Siam Paragon, Central World, and Lumphini Park.

claims.text: IGNIV Bangkok is a one-Michelin-star restaurant by Swiss chef Andreas Caminada.

findings.quote: Experience our one- MICHELIN star restaurant in downtown Bangkok. IGNIV Bangkok by Andreas Caminada
Imagined by Andreas Caminada, the Swiss founding chef of IGNIV

claims.text: Spanish interior designer Patricia Urquiola designed IGNIV's interiors.

findings.quote: acclaimed Spanish interior designer Patricia Urquiola infuses IGNIV's typical nest atmosphere with the energy & essence of Bangkok to create a feeling of comfort for indoor, bar & outdoor areas

claims.text: Zuma is a Japanese restaurant inspired by traditional izakaya.

findings.quote: Delight in an elegant, yet casual dining experience in downtown Bangkok at our Japanese restaurant inspired by traditional Izakaya.

claims.text: VIU serves Italian Mediterranean dishes inspired by Chef Matteo Fontana's heritage.

findings.quote: hearty and handcrafted Italian Mediterranean dishes, inspired by Chef Matteo Fontana’s heritage

claims.text: Afternoon tea is served overlooking the golf course, with TWG tea or coffee.

findings.quote: Overlooking the golf course’s verdant view, convene for sweet and savory bites, with TWG tea or coffee.

claims.text: Bathrooms are marble-lined, with a rainforest shower and a separate soaking tub.

findings.quote: each morning under a rainforest shower, part of your marble-lined bathroom with a separate soaking tub

claims.text: Caroline Astor Suites are corner suites with floor-to-ceiling windows and panoramic views of the city and parkland.

findings.quote: With a corner location and panoramic views of the sweeping cityscape and verdant parkland through floor-to-ceiling windows

claims.text: The hotel has a 15th-floor outdoor pool bar.

findings.quote: lounge on our hotel's 15th-floor outdoor pool bar

claims.text: The fitness center has a Thai boxing ring for one-to-one training.

findings.quote: the 24/7 fitness center features TechnoGym equipment, cardiovascular monitoring systems, and a Thai boxing ring for 1:1 training

claims.text: IGNIV Bangkok is the first IGNIV location outside Switzerland, built around a fine-dining sharing concept.

findings.quote: In its first location outside Switzerland, IGNIV by Andreas Caminada has spread its wings & landed to create a new nest at The St. Regis Bangkok.
IGNIV Bangkok is all about a unique fine dining sharing experience

claims.text: St. Regis Butler service is available 24 hours a day, and butlers can be reached at any hour by chat through the Marriott Bonvoy app.

findings.quote: hotel guests enjoy discreet signature St. Regis Butler service, 24 hours a day.
St. Regis Butler Service is accessible at any hour via chat using Marriott Bonvoy application

claims.text: The spa, Bangkok LIFE Longevity & Biohacking Hub, focuses on advanced diagnostics and biohacking, with treatments including cryotherapy, IV drips and hyperbaric oxygen chambers.

findings.quote: Bangkok LIFE Longevity & Biohacking Hub is an elite sanctuary for high performers seeking to optimise performance and wellbeing through advanced diagnostics and biohacking.
cryotherapy, Emsculpt body contouring, Cooltech fat freezing, IV drips, hyperbaric oxygen chambers, laser therapy

claims.text: The St. Regis Bar serves the Siam Mary, a Thai take on the St. Regis Bloody Mary.

findings.quote: The St. Regis Bar serves the signature St. Regis Bloody Mary with our unique Thai recipe, Siam Mary

claims.text: The Owner's Penthouse is a two-story, three-bedroom residence with a balcony and a private pool.

findings.quote: This one-of-a-kind two-story Penthouse offers a three-bedroom residence
3 Bedroom Penthouse Suite, Golf course view, Balcony, Private pool

claims.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.

findings.quote: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

claims.text: The pool has an attendant, but the hotel does not provide lifeguards.

findings.quote: There is a pool attendant but the hotel does not provide lifeguards.

findings.quote: Children of age 12 and under are not permitted to use the Exercise Room and spa facilities.
